description.value: Abby Pizza Place is a family-run pizza delivery and takeout shop on the outskirts of Abbotsford, also tagged in OSM as carrying convenience goods. It focuses on fast, hot pizza delivered to your door or available for pickup, making it a handy stop for a hungry cyclist passing through the Old Yale Road corridor. The combined pizza-and-convenience model means a touring cyclist may be able to grab both a hot meal and trail snacks in one stop.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 9m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real pizza delivery/takeout business at 33995 Old Yale Rd, Abbotsford, and the phone number 604-859-9777 matches the OSM tag exactly. The website refers to the business only as 'Abby Pizza Place' (no '& Convenience'), though OSM adds '& Convenience' alongside a shop=convenience tag. A minor postal code discrepancy exists (OSM: V2S 2K1 vs website /location/ page: V2S 4A5), and all blog posts are dated October 2012, suggesting the website has not been maintained, though the OSM record does not flag the business as closed.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM lists V2S 2K1 but the website /location/ page lists V2S 4A5 — address contact_confirmed set to false.
Business name on website is 'Abby Pizza Place' with no mention of '& Convenience', differing from the OSM name 'Abby Pizza Place & Convenience'.
All website blog posts are dated October 2012, indicating the site has not been updated in over a decade; current operating status could not be independently verified from the website alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible fast-food and convenience business at a confirmed Abbotsford address — useful to touring cyclists for hot food and convenience items.
